title: Setting the Deposit Held against a Hotel Rate Plans Departure Balance
content:
Whether the deposit already taken on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation lowers the balance settled at departure turns on whether a deposit stands on the folio and on where the reservation record stands.

## Basis of the offset

1. Where a deposit stands on the folio and the reservation stands at checked in, 100 percent of the deposit taken is set against the balance.
2. Where a deposit stands on the folio and the reservation stands at cancelled or recorded as a no show, 0 percent of it is set against the balance.
3. In every other case 0 percent of it is set against the balance.

## Standing by standing

| A deposit stands on the folio | Reservation record stands at | Share of the deposit set against the balance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | checked in | 100 percent |
| yes | cancelled | 0 percent |
| yes | recorded as a no show | 0 percent |
| yes | any other standing | 0 percent |
| no | any standing | 0 percent |

Checked in is the only standing on which any of the deposit is set against the balance.

## Applied to hypothetical figures

A deposit of 300.00 USD standing on the folio:

- With the reservation at checked in, 100 percent is set against the balance, lowering it by 300.00 USD.
- With the reservation at checked out, the third case governs and 0 percent is set against it, lowering it by 0.00 USD.
- With the reservation at cancelled or recorded as a no show, 0 percent is likewise set against it.
